title: The future of dentistry will be ethical
html: At a routine dental appointment, I paused at the front desk. Behind the counter was a promotional poster of my dentist, smiling beside an advertisement for Botox (Allergan Aesthetics). The practice was modern, reputable, and trusted. I was not surprised to see whitening brochures or veneer displays. Those had long been common. But this felt different. What did it mean for the identity of the profession when esthetic injections were marketed as readily as fluoride?
